items.title: Run package build after DONE merge when CLI runtime inputs changed
items.context: Detect the main merge before/after SHA in applyDoneMergeEffects and rebuild packages/main only when source/package runtime inputs changed.

items.title: Fail visibly when post-merge CLI rebuild fails
items.context: If rebuild fails after merge, surface a clear DONE post-merge error telling the user dist is stale and how to recover.

items.title: Cover rebuild trigger and skip cases with smoke tests
items.context: Add a focused task-level smoke around the changed-path predicate and post-DONE build hook behavior; avoid requiring real npm install or remote operations.
